title: Skyrace
description: A low-level air race through a mountain valley. Fly a stunt plane through 18 hoops in order, as fast as you can: the clock starts at the first hoop and a crash puts you back at the last one. Dive to gain speed, climb to trade it away, and save boost for when it counts; it drains while held and refills with every hoop. The touch stick banks and climbs the plane and levels it out when you let go. With a mouse, you aim and the plane follows, and WASD flies it by hand, loops included. Gamepads work too. Everything (terrain, trees, clouds, sound) is generated in code.
